last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 40
last_episode_to_air.overview: CHRIS tells ANSON that he has made it clear how he sees GRACE when he and GRACE were in the store-room alone when the A & E was sealed off. ANSON, however, points out that the three of them are actually putting themselves as well as the other to a test. SARAH is considering going to work in Singapore with HANG. YEUNG has come back suddenly. MC is thrilled. MARTHA has brought YEUNG back because she has heard that TIN has invited MC to go to the States. And she has made up her mind that she should let YEUNG decide where to receive his education. The blood clog in TY’s brain has been removed, but PAUL tells BETSY that TY’s days are numbered. TY has woken up; BETSY holds his hands and apologizes to him. PAUL lets MC know TY’s conviction as a doctor by telling him a story. MC and YEUNG go to the beach. YEUNG shows MC his support when he knows that MC is staying in Hong Kong. MC tells BETSY why he wanted to stay; BETSY is relieved.… ...

name: Healing Hands
overview: Medical drama that focuses on the lives and loves of the doctors and nurses at the fictional Yan Oi Hospital in Hong Kong.
